caution.title: Read this first
caution.description: DogeDrop has not been audited. Be careful. Test with a small amount only. A payment cannot be undone, and coins can be lost if something goes wrong.
hero.subtitle: A self-custodial Dogecoin wallet for IRC, social platforms, and the open web
info.title: Your wallet. Your keys. Your responsibility.
info.intro: DogeDrop is a self-custodial wallet. Your private keys and recovery phrase belong exclusively to you. They are generated and stored locally in your browser, never on our servers.
info.custody.title: Truly self-custodial
info.custody.description: We cannot access your wallet, view your recovery phrase, recover your password, or authorize transactions on your behalf. Your keys remain under your control.
info.backup.title: Back up your recovery phrase
info.backup.description: Your 12-word recovery phrase is the only reliable way to restore your wallet. Write it down and keep it somewhere safe, preferably offline. Never share it with anyone or enter it on an untrusted website.
info.backup.warning: If you lose your recovery phrase and access to your wallet, nobody can recover your funds. Not even us.
info.storage.title: Browser storage is not permanent
info.storage.description: Your encrypted wallet is stored in your browser's local storage. Clearing website data, using private browsing, changing devices, or browser storage cleanup may permanently remove the local copy.
info.storage.warning: Your Dogecoin remains on the blockchain, but without your recovery phrase you may lose access to it.
info.metaldoge.title: MetalDoge is experimental
info.metaldoge.description: DogeDrop supports Dogecoin and DogecoinVM, part of the emerging MetalDoge ecosystem. DogecoinVM technology is still experimental and should be considered alpha software.
info.metaldoge.warning: Features, infrastructure, and network behavior may change. Use small amounts and understand the risks before experimenting.
info.opensource.title: Open technology
info.opensource.prefix: This wallet is based on the open-source
info.opensource.author: originally developed by Paulo Vidal, and further developed by
info.opensource.mission: Our goal is to bring self-custodial Dogecoin payments to the SimosNap IRC Network and Monoverse, our framework for extending IRC channels with social features and web integration. The wallet remains open source and available for anyone who wants to integrate it into their own website or application.
info.opensource.warning: The wallet has not been independently audited. Always exercise caution when using experimental financial software.
connect.title: Try the button
connect.description: Connect shares the address with this page. Every payment still asks first.
integration.title: Paste one line
integration.step1: Add the line before the end of the page.
integration.step2: A wallet button appears for the visitor.
integration.step3: Your site asks. The visitor approves.
integration.snippetNote: The wallet loads from dogedrop.org/wallet, so another site cannot read the keys. This guide is on the same address, and the wallet says so.
integration.fork.title: Prefer our fork?
integration.fork.description: You can also integrate the SimosNap fork of DogeDrop into your website. It is based on the original open-source project and developed for the SimosNap IRC Network and Monoverse.
integration.docs.title: Developer documentation
integration.docs.description: Want to build your own integration? Explore the DogeDrop JavaScript API to connect wallets, request payments, and integrate Dogecoin functionality into your website, application, or IRC client.

payments.warning: The address looks the same. The coins are separate.
